gemini.rationale: The transaction is a joint venture where Micron acquired a minority stake in Inotera and shared control with NTC. The product (T4), processes (T5), and organization (T6) all remained within Inotera, with Micron and NTC taking output via supply agreements. Because the operational layers remained together inside the JV entity, there is no structural mismatch (gap_45=0, gap_56=0).
